ver: Version counter. Starts at 1; incremented on every write.
meta.title: Application name, copied from PRD meta.title.
meta.updated_at: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last write.
modules_implemented: List of BE shared module names that have been generated — e.g. 'auth-middleware', 'error-handler', 'db-client', 'pagination-helper', 'integration-[name]'. Used in update mode to detect which BE modules need regeneration when shared-decisions changes.
fe_modules_implemented: List of FE shared module names that have been generated — e.g. 'api-client', 'auth-store', 'router', 'fe-error-handler'. Used in update mode to detect which FE modules need regeneration when tech stack or shared-decisions changes.
test_infrastructure.framework: Test framework used for BE tests — e.g. 'jest', 'pytest', 'JUnit'. Derived from arch_spec.tech_stack.
test_infrastructure.config_file_path: Relative path to the BE test framework config file — e.g. 'jest.config.js', 'pytest.ini', 'build.gradle'.
env_vars_required: All environment variables required to run the application. Includes BE vars (DB connection, auth secrets, external service credentials) and FE vars (API base URL, public config). Source of truth for .env.example.
env_vars_required[].name: Environment variable name in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE — e.g. 'DATABASE_URL', 'JWT_SECRET', 'VITE_API_BASE_URL'.
env_vars_required[].description: What this variable is used for and example format — e.g. 'PostgreSQL connection string. Format: postgresql://user:pass@host:port/dbname'.
files_generated: Complete list of BE shared module files generated (auth middleware, error handler, DB client, integration clients, pagination helper, test config, .env.example), as relative paths from the project root.
fe_files_generated: Complete list of FE shared module files generated (api-client, auth-store, router, fe-error-handler), as relative paths from the project root.
setup_notes: Notes produced during generation — e.g. 'Copy .env.example to .env and fill in values before starting', 'Run database migrations after setting DATABASE_URL'. Empty array if none.
